description: Find the pages of articles read with formulas (read_pdf_text) that hold every word asked — a name, a term, a fragment of TeX such as '\pi_{n+k}'. Each hit: the file's id and name, its wiki page, the page of the PDF and a snippet. Only files on pages you may read. For the project's issues, pages and other files use find_issues / search_wiki.

limit.description: How many pages, at most 30. Default 10.

query.description: Words to find, all of them.

name: search_pdf_texts
title: Search pdf texts
